observedCapability: internal-mutation v0.4 verifies traceable source references, operation labels, provenance preservation, and that mutated outputs are not exact source-value copies
gap: A proposal can cite two valid source traits and emit an arbitrary third value under a mutating operation. Current structural checks can prove traceability and non-copying, but cannot prove that the output was causally produced by decomposing and recombining the cited sources.
risk: ZENOMORPH could mistake decorative provenance for genuine mining: a candidate may look cross-modal or phenotype-coupled because its metadata names text and visual ore even when the output was not materially derived from them.
requiredNextEvidence: Add an isolated derivation witness or transformation trace that binds output features to source features without pretending to solve semantic causality generally.
Adversarially test arbitrary-output laundering, source-label swapping, and provenance-only cross-pressure claims.
Require GUT/VAJRA review to distinguish traceable transformation evidence from unsupported causal derivation claims.
Run MUTHER unit tests and cross-organ regression before any public capability promotion.
boundary: This failure record does not invalidate the existing sandbox. It narrows the claim: current evidence supports traceable non-copy transformation, not verified causal recombination or autonomous aesthetic judgment.
